verses.textZh: 奉我们的救主神，和我们的盼望基督耶稣的命令，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉我们的救主神，和我们的盼望基督耶稣的命令，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，
verses.textZhCuv: 奉我们救主神和我们的盼望基督耶稣之命，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, by the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ, our hope,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, appointed by the command of God our Savior and Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Savior, and of Christ Jesus, who is our hope,
verses.textEn: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

verses.textZh: 写信给因信主而作我真儿子的提摩太。愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父神和我们的主基督耶稣临到你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 写信给因信主而作我真儿子的提摩太。愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父神和我们的主基督耶稣临到你。
verses.textZhCuv: 写信给那因信主作我真儿子的提摩太。愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父神和我们主基督耶稣归与你！
verses.textEnNiv: To Timothy my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Timothy, a true son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to Timothy, my true son in the faith. May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: To Timothy, my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEn: To Timothy my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.textZh: 我往马其顿去的时候，曾经劝你留在以弗所，为要嘱咐某些人，不可传别的教义，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我往马其顿去的时候，曾经劝你留在以弗所，为要嘱咐某些人，不可传别的教义，
verses.textZhCuv: 我往马其顿去的时候，曾劝你仍住在以弗所，好嘱咐那几个人不可传异教，
verses.textEnNiv: As I urged you when I went into Macedonia, stay there in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach false doctrines any longer
verses.textEnEsv: As I urged you when I was going to Macedonia, remain at Ephesus so that you may charge certain persons not to teach any different doctrine,
verses.textEnNkjv: As I urged you when I went into Macedonia—remain in Ephesus that you may charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.textEnNlt: When I left for Macedonia, I urged you to stay there in Ephesus and stop those whose teaching is contrary to the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as I urged you upon my departure for Macedonia, to remain on at Ephesus so that you would instruct certain people not to teach strange doctrines,
verses.textEn: As I urged you when I went into Macedonia, stay there in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach false doctrines any longer

verses.textZh: 也不可沉迷于无稽之谈和无穷的家谱；这些事只能引起争论，对于神在信仰上所定的计划是毫无帮助的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不可沉迷于无稽之谈和无穷的家谱；这些事只能引起争论，对于神在信仰上所定的计划是毫无帮助的。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不可听从荒渺无凭的话语和无穷的家谱；这等事只生辩论，并不发明神在信上所立的章程。
verses.textEnNiv: or to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies. Such things promote controversial speculations rather than advancing God’s work—which is by faith.
verses.textEnEsv: nor to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculations rather than the stewardship from God that is by faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than godly edification which is in faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let them waste their time in endless discussion of myths and spiritual pedigrees. These things only lead to meaningless speculations, which don’t help people live a life of faith in God.
verses.textEnNasb: nor to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which give rise to useless speculation rather than advance the plan of God, which is by faith, so I urge you now.
verses.textEn: or to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies. Such things promote controversial speculations rather than advancing God’s work—which is by faith.

verses.textZh: 这嘱咐的目的是出于爱；这爱是发自纯洁的心、无愧的良心和无伪的信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这嘱咐的目的是出于爱；这爱是发自纯洁的心、无愧的良心和无伪的信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 但命令的总归就是爱；这爱是从清洁的心和无亏的良心，无伪的信心生出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: The goal of this command is love, which comes from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.
verses.textEnEsv: The aim of our charge is love that issues from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the purpose of the commandment is love from a pure heart, from a good conscience, and from sincere faith,
verses.textEnNlt: The purpose of my instruction is that all believers would be filled with love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and genuine faith.
verses.textEnNasb: But the goal of our instruction is love from a pure heart, from a good conscience, and from a sincere faith.
verses.textEn: The goal of this command is love, which comes from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.

verses.textZh: 有些人偏离了这些，就转向无意义的辩论，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人偏离了这些，就转向无意义的辩论，
verses.textZhCuv: 有人偏离这些，反去讲虚浮的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Some have departed from these and have turned to meaningless talk.
verses.textEnEsv: Certain persons, by swerving from these, have wandered away into vain discussion,
verses.textEnNkjv: from which some, having strayed, have turned aside to idle talk,
verses.textEnNlt: But some people have missed this whole point. They have turned away from these things and spend their time in meaningless discussions.
verses.textEnNasb: Some people have strayed from these things and have turned aside to fruitless discussion,
verses.textEn: Some have departed from these and have turned to meaningless talk.

verses.textZh: 想要作律法教师，却不明白自己讲的是甚么，主张的又是甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 想要作律法教师，却不明白自己讲的是甚么，主张的又是甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 想要作教法师，却不明白自己所讲说的所论定的。
verses.textEnNiv: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not know what they are talking about or what they so confidently affirm.
verses.textEnEsv: desiring to be teachers of the law, without understanding either what they are saying or the things about which they make confident assertions.
verses.textEnNkjv: desiring to be teachers of the law, understanding neither what they say nor the things which they affirm.
verses.textEnNlt: They want to be known as teachers of the law of Moses, but they don’t know what they are talking about, even though they speak so confidently.
verses.textEnNasb: wanting to be teachers of the Law, even though they do not understand either what they are saying or the matters about which they make confident assertions.
verses.textEn: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not know what they are talking about or what they so confidently affirm.

verses.textZh: 我们知道律法是好的，只要应用得恰当。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道律法是好的，只要应用得恰当。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们知道律法原是好的，只要人用得合宜；
verses.textEnNiv: We know that the law is good if one uses it properly.
verses.textEnEsv: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it lawfully,
verses.textEnNkjv: But we know that the law is good if one uses it lawfully,
verses.textEnNlt: We know that the law is good when used correctly.
verses.textEnNasb: But we know that the Law is good, if one uses it lawfully,
verses.textEn: We know that the law is good if one uses it properly.

verses.textZh: 要知道律法本来不是为义人设立的，而是为那些无法无天和放荡不羁的、不敬虔和犯罪的、不圣洁和世俗的、弒父母和杀人的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 要知道律法本来不是为义人设立的，而是为那些无法无天和放荡不羁的、不敬虔和犯罪的、不圣洁和世俗的、弒父母和杀人的、
verses.textZhCuv: 因为律法不是为义人设立的，乃是为不法和不服的，不虔诚和犯罪的，不圣洁和恋世俗的，弑父母和杀人的，
verses.textEnNiv: We also know that the law is made not for the righteous but for lawbreakers and rebels, the ungodly and sinful, the unholy and irreligious, for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,
verses.textEnEsv: understanding this, that the law is not laid down for the just but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for those who strike their fathers and mothers, for murderers,
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing this: that the law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and for sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.textEnNlt: For the law was not intended for people who do what is right. It is for people who are lawless and rebellious, who are ungodly and sinful, who consider nothing sacred and defile what is holy, who kill their father or mother or commit other murders.
verses.textEnNasb: realizing the fact that law is not made for a righteous person but for those who are lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and worldly, for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,
verses.textEn: We also know that the law is made not for the righteous but for lawbreakers and rebels, the ungodly and sinful, the unholy and irreligious, for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,

verses.textZh: 淫乱的、亲男色的、拐带人口的、说谎话的、发假誓的，以及为其他抵挡纯正教训的人设立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 淫乱的、亲男色的、拐带人口的、说谎话的、发假誓的，以及为其他抵挡纯正教训的人设立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 行淫和亲男色的，抢人口和说谎话的，并起假誓的，或是为别样敌正道的事设立的。
verses.textEnNiv: for the sexually immoral, for those practicing homosexuality, for slave traders and liars and perjurers—and for whatever else is contrary to the sound doctrine
verses.textEnEsv: the sexually immoral, men who practice homosexuality, enslavers, liars, perjurers, and whatever else is contrary to sound doctrine,
verses.textEnNkjv: for fornicators, for sodomites, for kidnappers, for liars, for perjurers, and if there is any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine,
verses.textEnNlt: The law is for people who are sexually immoral, or who practice homosexuality, or are slave traders, liars, promise breakers, or who do anything else that contradicts the wholesome teaching
verses.textEnNasb: for the sexually immoral, homosexuals, slave traders, liars, perjurers, and whatever else is contrary to sound teaching,
verses.textEn: for the sexually immoral, for those practicing homosexuality, for slave traders and liars and perjurers—and for whatever else is contrary to the sound doctrine

verses.textZh: 这是照着可称颂之神所交托我的荣耀福音说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是照着可称颂之神所交托我的荣耀福音说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是照着可称颂之神交托我荣耀福音说的。
verses.textEnNiv: that conforms to the gospel concerning the glory of the blessed God, which he entrusted to me.
verses.textEnEsv: in accordance with the gospel of the glory of the blessed God with which I have been entrusted.
verses.textEnNkjv: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God which was committed to my trust.
verses.textEnNlt: that comes from the glorious Good News entrusted to me by our blessed God.
verses.textEnNasb: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.
verses.textEn: that conforms to the gospel concerning the glory of the blessed God, which he entrusted to me.

verses.textZh: 我感谢那赐我能力的、我们的主基督耶稣，因为他认为我有忠心，派我服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我感谢那赐我能力的、我们的主基督耶稣，因为他认为我有忠心，派我服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我感谢那给我力量的我们主基督耶稣，因他以我有忠心，派我服事他。
verses.textEnNiv: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength, that he considered me trustworthy, appointing me to his service.
verses.textEnEsv: I thank him who has given me strength, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he judged me faithful, appointing me to his service,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord who has enabled me, because He counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry,
verses.textEnNlt: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength to do his work. He considered me trustworthy and appointed me to serve him,
verses.textEnNasb: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, because He considered me faithful, putting me into service,
verses.textEn: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength, that he considered me trustworthy, appointing me to his service.

verses.textZh: 我从前是亵渎神的、迫害人的、凌辱人的，然而我还蒙了怜悯，因为我是在不信的时候，由于无知而作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从前是亵渎神的、迫害人的、凌辱人的，然而我还蒙了怜悯，因为我是在不信的时候，由于无知而作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前是亵渎神的，逼迫人的，侮慢人的；然而我还蒙了怜悯，因我是不信不明白的时候而做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Even though I was once a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent man, I was shown mercy because I acted in ignorance and unbelief.
verses.textEnEsv: though formerly I was a blasphemer, persecutor, and insolent opponent. But I received mercy because I had acted ignorantly in unbelief,
verses.textEnNkjv: although I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and an insolent man; but I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.textEnNlt: even though I used to blaspheme the name of Christ. In my insolence, I persecuted his people. But God had mercy on me because I did it in ignorance and unbelief.
verses.textEnNasb: even though I was previously a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent aggressor. Yet I was shown mercy because I acted ignorantly in unbelief;
verses.textEn: Even though I was once a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent man, I was shown mercy because I acted in ignorance and unbelief.

verses.textZh: 我们主的恩典，随着在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，在我身上越发增加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们主的恩典，随着在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，在我身上越发增加。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我主的恩是格外丰盛，使我在基督耶稣里有信心和爱心。
verses.textEnNiv: The grace of our Lord was poured out on me abundantly, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: and the grace of our Lord overflowed for me with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceedingly abundant, with faith and love which are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, how generous and gracious our Lord was! He filled me with the faith and love that come from Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: and the grace of our Lord was more than abundant, with the faith and love which are found in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: The grace of our Lord was poured out on me abundantly, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: "基督耶稣降世，为要拯救罪人。"这话是可信的，是值得完全接纳的。在罪人中我是个罪魁。
verses.textZhCnvs: "基督耶稣降世，为要拯救罪人。"这话是可信的，是值得完全接纳的。在罪人中我是个罪魁。
verses.textZhCuv: 「基督耶稣降世，为要拯救罪人。」这话是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是个罪魁。
verses.textEnNiv: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—of whom I am the worst.
verses.textEnEsv: The saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the foremost.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a trustworthy saying, and everyone should accept it: "Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners"—and I am the worst of them all.
verses.textEnNasb: It is a trustworthy statement, deserving full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, among whom I am foremost.
verses.textEn: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—of whom I am the worst.

verses.textZh: 可是，我竟然蒙了怜悯，好让基督耶稣在我这个罪魁身上，显明他完全的忍耐，给后来信他得永生的人作榜样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，我竟然蒙了怜悯，好让基督耶稣在我这个罪魁身上，显明他完全的忍耐，给后来信他得永生的人作榜样。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我蒙了怜悯，是因耶稣基督要在我这罪魁身上显明他一切的忍耐，给后来信他得永生的人作榜样。
verses.textEnNiv: But for that very reason I was shown mercy so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display his immense patience as an example for those who would believe in him and receive eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: But I received mercy for this reason, that in me, as the foremost, Jesus Christ might display his perfect patience as an example to those who were to believe in him for eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, for this reason I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show all longsuffering, as a pattern to those who are going to believe on Him for everlasting life.
verses.textEnNlt: But God had mercy on me so that Christ Jesus could use me as a prime example of his great patience with even the worst sinners. Then others will realize that they, too, can believe in him and receive eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet for this reason I found mercy, so that in me as the foremost sinner Jesus Christ might demonstrate His perfect patience as an example for those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
verses.textEn: But for that very reason I was shown mercy so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display his immense patience as an example for those who would believe in him and receive eternal life.

verses.textZh: 但愿尊贵荣耀归给万世的君王，就是那不朽坏、人不能见、独一的神，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿尊贵荣耀归给万世的君王，就是那不朽坏、人不能见、独一的神，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿尊贵、荣耀归与那不能朽坏、不能看见、永世的君王、独一的神，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: To the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: All honor and glory to God forever and ever! He is the eternal King, the unseen one who never dies; he alone is God. Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEn: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.textZh: 我儿提摩太啊！我照着从前关于你的预言，把这命令交托你，为的是要叫你借着这些预言打那美好的仗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿提摩太啊！我照着从前关于你的预言，把这命令交托你，为的是要叫你借着这些预言打那美好的仗。
verses.textZhCuv: 我儿提摩太啊，我照从前指着你的预言，将这命令交托你，叫你因此可以打那美好的仗。
verses.textEnNiv: Timothy, my son, I am giving you this command in keeping with the prophecies once made about you, so that by recalling them you may fight the battle well,
verses.textEnEsv: This charge I entrust to you, Timothy, my child, in accordance with the prophecies previously made about you, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
verses.textEnNkjv: This charge I commit to you, son Timothy, according to the prophecies previously made concerning you, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
verses.textEnNlt: Timothy, my son, here are my instructions for you, based on the prophetic words spoken about you earlier. May they help you fight well in the Lord’s battles.
verses.textEnNasb: This command I entrust to you, Timothy, my son, in accordance with the prophecies previously made concerning you, that by them you fight the good fight,
verses.textEn: Timothy, my son, I am giving you this command in keeping with the prophecies once made about you, so that by recalling them you may fight the battle well,

verses.textZh: 常常存着信心和无愧的良心。有些人丢弃良心，就在信仰上失落了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常常存着信心和无愧的良心。有些人丢弃良心，就在信仰上失落了。
verses.textZhCuv: 常存信心和无亏的良心。有人丢弃良心，就在真道上如同船破坏了一般。
verses.textEnNiv: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and so have suffered shipwreck with regard to the faith.
verses.textEnEsv: holding faith and a good conscience. By rejecting this, some have made shipwreck of their faith,
verses.textEnNkjv: having faith and a good conscience, which some having rejected, concerning the faith have suffered shipwreck,
verses.textEnNlt: Cling to your faith in Christ, and keep your conscience clear. For some people have deliberately violated their consciences; as a result, their faith has been shipwrecked.
verses.textEnNasb: keeping faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and suffered shipwreck in regard to their faith.
verses.textEn: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and so have suffered shipwreck with regard to the faith.

verses.textZh: 他们当中有许米乃和亚历山大，我已经把他们交给撒但，使他们受管教不再亵渎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们当中有许米乃和亚历山大，我已经把他们交给撒但，使他们受管教不再亵渎。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有许米乃和亚历山大；我已经把他们交给撒但，使他们受责罚就不再谤渎了。
verses.textEnNiv: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
verses.textEnEsv: among whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.textEnNkjv: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.textEnNlt: Hymenaeus and Alexander are two examples. I threw them out and handed them over to Satan so they might learn not to blaspheme God.
verses.textEnNasb: Among these are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan, so that they will be taught not to blaspheme.
verses.textEn: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.

verses.textZh: 在我们的救主神看来，这是美好的，可蒙悦纳的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我们的救主神看来，这是美好的，可蒙悦纳的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我劝你，第一要为万人恳求、祷告、代求、祝谢；
verses.textEnNiv: I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people—
verses.textEnEsv: First of all, then, I urge that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for all people,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I exhort first of all that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks be made for all men,
verses.textEnNlt: I urge you, first of all, to pray for all people. Ask God to help them; intercede on their behalf, and give thanks for them.
verses.textEnNasb: First of all, then, I urge that requests, prayers, intercession, and thanksgiving be made in behalf of all people,
verses.textEn: I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people—

verses.textZh: 他愿意万人得救，并且充分认识真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他愿意万人得救，并且充分认识真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 为君王和一切在位的，也该如此，使我们可以敬虔、端正、平安无事地度日。
verses.textEnNiv: for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.
verses.textEnEsv: for kings and all who are in high positions, that we may lead a peaceful and quiet life, godly and dignified in every way.
verses.textEnNkjv: for kings and all who are in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and reverence.
verses.textEnNlt: Pray this way for kings and all who are in authority so that we can live peaceful and quiet lives marked by godliness and dignity.
verses.textEnNasb: for kings and all who are in authority, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.
verses.textEn: for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.

verses.textZh: 因为神只有一位，在神和人中间也只有一位中保，就是降世为人的基督耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神只有一位，在神和人中间也只有一位中保，就是降世为人的基督耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是好的，在神我们救主面前可蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: This is good, and pleases God our Savior,
verses.textEnEsv: This is good, and it is pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
verses.textEnNlt: This is good and pleases God our Savior,
verses.textEnNasb: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
verses.textEn: This is good, and pleases God our Savior,

verses.textZh: 他舍了自己作万人的赎价，到了适当的时候，这事就证实了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他舍了自己作万人的赎价，到了适当的时候，这事就证实了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他愿意万人得救，明白真道。
verses.textEnNiv: who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: who desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: who desires all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: who wants everyone to be saved and to understand the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: who wants all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.textEn: who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

verses.textZh: 为了这事，我也被派作传道的和使徒 ，在信仰和真理上作外族人的教师。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这事，我也被派作传道的和使徒 ，在信仰和真理上作外族人的教师。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为只有一位神，在神和人中间，只有一位中保，乃是降世为人的基督耶稣；
verses.textEnNiv: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnEsv: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: For thereis one God and one Mediator between God and men, the Man Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: For, There is one God and one Mediator who can reconcile God and humanity—the man Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: For there is one God, and one mediator also between God and mankind, the Man Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,

verses.textZh: 因此，我愿意男人没有忿怒，没有争论，举起圣洁的手随处祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我愿意男人没有忿怒，没有争论，举起圣洁的手随处祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他舍自己作万人的赎价，到了时候，这事必证明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: who gave himself as a ransom for all people. This has now been witnessed to at the proper time.
verses.textEnEsv: who gave himself as a ransom for all, which is the testimony given at the proper time.
verses.textEnNkjv: who gave Himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time,
verses.textEnNlt: He gave his life to purchase freedom for everyone. This is the message God gave to the world at just the right time.
verses.textEnNasb: who gave Himself as a ransom for all, the testimony given at the proper time.
verses.textEn: who gave himself as a ransom for all people. This has now been witnessed to at the proper time.

verses.textZh: 照样，我也愿意女人以端正、娴淑、自律为装饰；不要以鬈发、金饰、珠宝，或名贵衣裳为装饰，
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，我也愿意女人以端正、娴淑、自律为装饰；不要以鬈发、金饰、珠宝，或名贵衣裳为装饰，
verses.textZhCuv: 我为此奉派作传道的，作使徒，作外邦人的师傅，教导他们相信，学习真道。我说的是真话，并不是谎言。
verses.textEnNiv: And for this purpose I was appointed a herald and an apostle—I am telling the truth, I am not lying—and a true and faithful teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.textEnEsv: For this I was appointed a preacher and an apostle ( I am telling the truth, I am not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: for which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am speaking the truth in Christ and not lying— a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
verses.textEnNlt: And I have been chosen as a preacher and apostle to teach the Gentiles this message about faith and truth. I’m not exaggerating—just telling the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: For this I was appointed as a preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth, I am not lying), as a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
verses.textEn: And for this purpose I was appointed a herald and an apostle—I am telling the truth, I am not lying—and a true and faithful teacher of the Gentiles.

verses.textZh: 却要以善行作装饰，这才配称为敬畏神的女人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却要以善行作装饰，这才配称为敬畏神的女人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿男人无忿怒，无争论 ，举起圣洁的手，随处祷告；
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or disputing.
verses.textEnEsv: I desire then that in every place the men should pray, lifting holy hands without anger or quarreling;
verses.textEnNkjv: I desire therefore that the men pray everywhere, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting;
verses.textEnNlt: In every place of worship, I want men to pray with holy hands lifted up to God, free from anger and controversy.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger and dispute.
verses.textEn: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or disputing.

verses.textZh: 女人应该安静而又完全顺服地学习。
verses.textZhCnvs: 女人应该安静而又完全顺服地学习。
verses.textZhCuv: 又愿女人廉耻、自守，以正派衣裳为妆饰，不以编发、黄金、珍珠，和贵价的衣裳为妆饰，
verses.textEnNiv: I also want the women to dress modestly, with decency and propriety, adorning themselves, not with elaborate hairstyles or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
verses.textEnEsv: likewise also that women should adorn themselves in respectable apparel, with modesty and self-control, not with braided hair and gold or pearls or costly attire,
verses.textEnNkjv: in like manner also, that the women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with propriety and moderation, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or costly clothing,
verses.textEnNlt: And I want women to be modest in their appearance. They should wear decent and appropriate clothing and not draw attention to themselves by the way they fix their hair or by wearing gold or pearls or expensive clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise, I want women to adorn themselves with proper clothing, modestly and discreetly, not with braided hair and gold or pearls or expensive apparel,
verses.textEn: I also want the women to dress modestly, with decency and propriety, adorning themselves, not with elaborate hairstyles or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,

verses.textZh: 我不准女人教导，或辖制男人；女人总要安静。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不准女人教导，或辖制男人；女人总要安静。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要有善行，这才与自称是敬神的女人相宜。
verses.textEnNiv: but with good deeds, appropriate for women who profess to worship God.
verses.textEnEsv: but with what is proper for women who profess godliness—with good works.
verses.textEnNkjv: but, which is proper for women professing godliness, with good works.
verses.textEnNlt: For women who claim to be devoted to God should make themselves attractive by the good things they do.
verses.textEnNasb: but rather by means of good works, as is proper for women making a claim to godliness.
verses.textEn: but with good deeds, appropriate for women who profess to worship God.

verses.textZh: 因为先造的是亚当，后造的是夏娃；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为先造的是亚当，后造的是夏娃；
verses.textZhCuv: 女人要沉静学道，一味地顺服。
verses.textEnNiv: A woman should learn in quietness and full submission.
verses.textEnEsv: Let a woman learn quietly with all submissiveness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let a woman learn in silence with all submission.
verses.textEnNlt: Women should learn quietly and submissively.
verses.textEnNasb: A woman must quietly receive instruction with entire submissiveness.
verses.textEn: A woman should learn in quietness and full submission.

verses.textZh: 不是亚当受了引诱，而是女人受了引诱，陷在过犯里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不是亚当受了引诱，而是女人受了引诱，陷在过犯里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不许女人讲道，也不许她辖管男人，只要沉静。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not permit a woman to teach or to assume authority over a man; she must be quiet.
verses.textEnEsv: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; rather, she is to remain quiet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I do not permit a woman to teach or to have authority over a man, but to be in silence.
verses.textEnNlt: I do not let women teach men or have authority over them. Let them listen quietly.
verses.textEnNasb: But I do not allow a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man, but to remain quiet.
verses.textEn: I do not permit a woman to teach or to assume authority over a man; she must be quiet.

verses.textZh: 然而女人要是常常存着信心、爱心、圣洁自律，在她生育的事上必定得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而女人要是常常存着信心、爱心、圣洁自律，在她生育的事上必定得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为先造的是亚当，后造的是夏娃，
verses.textEnNiv: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
verses.textEnEsv: For Adam was formed first, then Eve;
verses.textEnNkjv: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
verses.textEnNlt: For God made Adam first, and afterward he made Eve.
verses.textEnNasb: For it was Adam who was first created, and then Eve.
verses.textEn: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

verses.textZh: 且不是亚当被引诱，乃是女人被引诱，陷在罪里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 且不是亚当被引诱，乃是女人被引诱，陷在罪里。
verses.textZhCuv: 且不是亚当被引诱，乃是女人被引诱，陷在罪里。
verses.textEnNiv: And Adam was not the one deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and became a sinner.
verses.textEnEsv: and Adam was not deceived, but the woman was deceived and became a transgressor.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived, fell into transgression.
verses.textEnNlt: And it was not Adam who was deceived by Satan. The woman was deceived, and sin was the result.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman was deceived and became a wrongdoer.
verses.textEn: And Adam was not the one deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and became a sinner.

verses.textZh: 然而，女人若常存信心、爱心，又圣洁自守，就必在生产上得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，女人若常存信心、爱心，又圣洁自守，就必在生产上得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，女人若常存信心、爱心，又圣洁自守，就必在生产上得救。
verses.textEnNiv: But women will be saved through childbearing—if they continue in faith, love and holiness with propriety.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet she will be saved through childbearing—if they continue in faith and love and holiness, with self-control.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless she will be saved in childbearing if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
verses.textEnNlt: But women will be saved through childbearing, assuming they continue to live in faith, love, holiness, and modesty.
verses.textEnNasb: But women will be preserved through childbirth—if they continue in faith, love, and sanctity, with moderation.
verses.textEn: But women will be saved through childbearing—if they continue in faith, love and holiness with propriety.

verses.textZh: "如果有人渴慕监督的职分，他就是爱慕善工。"这话是可信的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人渴慕监督的职分，他就是爱慕善工。"这话是可信的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若想要得监督的职分，就是羡慕善工。」这话是可信的。
verses.textEnNiv: Here is a trustworthy saying: Whoever aspires to be an overseer desires a noble task.
verses.textEnEsv: The saying is trustworthy: If anyone aspires to the office of overseer, he desires a noble task.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is a faithful saying: If a man desires the position of a bishop, he desires a good work.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a trustworthy saying: "If someone aspires to be a church leader, he desires an honorable position."
verses.textEnNasb: It is a trustworthy statement: if any man aspires to the office of overseer, it is a fine work he desires to do.
verses.textEn: Here is a trustworthy saying: Whoever aspires to be an overseer desires a noble task.

verses.textZh: 所以作监督的，必须无可指摘，只作一个妻子的丈夫，有节制，自律，庄重，乐意接待客旅，善于教导，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以作监督的，必须无可指摘，只作一个妻子的丈夫，有节制，自律，庄重，乐意接待客旅，善于教导，
verses.textZhCuv: 作监督的，必须无可指责，只作一个妇人的丈夫，有节制，自守，端正，乐意接待远人，善于教导；
verses.textEnNiv: Now the overseer is to be above reproach, faithful to his wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore an overseer must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, sober-minded, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
verses.textEnNkjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober-minded, of good behavior, hospitable, able to teach;
verses.textEnNlt: So a church leader must be a man whose life is above reproach. He must be faithful to his wife. He must exercise self-control, live wisely, and have a good reputation. He must enjoy having guests in his home, and he must be able to teach.
verses.textEnNasb: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, skillful in teaching,
verses.textEn: Now the overseer is to be above reproach, faithful to his wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,

verses.textZh: 不好酒，不打人，只要温和，与人无争，不贪财，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不好酒，不打人，只要温和，与人无争，不贪财，
verses.textZhCuv: 不因酒滋事，不打人，只要温和，不争竞，不贪财；
verses.textEnNiv: not given to drunkenness, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.
verses.textEnEsv: not a drunkard, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.
verses.textEnNkjv: not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
verses.textEnNlt: He must not be a heavy drinker or be violent. He must be gentle, not quarrelsome, and not love money.
verses.textEnNasb: not overindulging in wine, not a bully, but gentle, not contentious, free from the love of money.
verses.textEn: not given to drunkenness, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.

verses.textZh: 好好管理自己的家，使儿女凡事敬重顺服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好好管理自己的家，使儿女凡事敬重顺服。
verses.textZhCuv: 好好管理自己的家，使儿女凡事端庄顺服 。
verses.textEnNiv: He must manage his own family well and see that his children obey him, and he must do so in a manner worthy of full respect.
verses.textEnEsv: He must manage his own household well, with all dignity keeping his children submissive,
verses.textEnNkjv: one who rules his own house well, having his children in submission with all reverence
verses.textEnNlt: He must manage his own family well, having children who respect and obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: He must be one who manages his own household well, keeping his children under control with all dignity
verses.textEn: He must manage his own family well and see that his children obey him, and he must do so in a manner worthy of full respect.

verses.textZh: 初信主的不可作监督，恐怕他骄傲，就落在魔鬼所受的刑罚里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 初信主的不可作监督，恐怕他骄傲，就落在魔鬼所受的刑罚里。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若不知道管理自己的家，焉能照管神的教会呢？
verses.textEnNiv: (If anyone does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God’s church?)
verses.textEnEsv: for if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for God’s church?
verses.textEnNkjv: (for if a man does not know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the church of God?);
verses.textEnNlt: For if a man cannot manage his own household, how can he take care of God’s church?
verses.textEnNasb: (but if a man does not know how to manage his own household, how will he take care of the church of God?),
verses.textEn: (If anyone does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God’s church?)

verses.textZh: 作监督的也必须在教外有好声誉，免得他被人毁谤，就落在魔鬼的陷阱里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作监督的也必须在教外有好声誉，免得他被人毁谤，就落在魔鬼的陷阱里。
verses.textZhCuv: 初入教的不可作监督，恐怕他自高自大，就落在魔鬼所受的刑罚里。
verses.textEnNiv: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same judgment as the devil.
verses.textEnEsv: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become puffed up with conceit and fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.textEnNkjv: not a novice, lest being puffed up with pride he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
verses.textEnNlt: A church leader must not be a new believer, because he might become proud, and the devil would cause him to fall.
verses.textEnNasb: and not a new convert, so that he will not become conceited and fall into condemnation incurred by the devil.
verses.textEn: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same judgment as the devil.

verses.textZh: 照样，执事也必须庄重，不一口两舌，不酗酒，不贪不义之财，
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，执事也必须庄重，不一口两舌，不酗酒，不贪不义之财，
verses.textZhCuv: 监督也必须在教外有好名声，恐怕被人毁谤，落在魔鬼的网罗里。
verses.textEnNiv: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil’s trap.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, he must be well thought of by outsiders, so that he may not fall into disgrace, into a snare of the devil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover he must have a good testimony among those who are outside, lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.textEnNlt: Also, people outside the church must speak well of him so that he will not be disgraced and fall into the devil’s trap.
verses.textEnNasb: And he must have a good reputation with those outside the church, so that he will not fall into disgrace and the snare of the devil.
verses.textEn: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil’s trap.

verses.textZh: 用清洁的良心持守信仰的奥秘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用清洁的良心持守信仰的奥秘。
verses.textZhCuv: 作执事的，也是如此：必须端庄，不一口两舌，不好喝酒，不贪不义之财；
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, deacons are to be worthy of respect, sincere, not indulging in much wine, and not pursuing dishonest gain.
verses.textEnEsv: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for dishonest gain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise deacons mustbe reverent, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy for money,
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, deacons must be well respected and have integrity. They must not be heavy drinkers or dishonest with money.
verses.textEnNasb: Deacons likewise must be men of dignity, not insincere, not prone to drink much wine, not greedy for money,
verses.textEn: In the same way, deacons are to be worthy of respect, sincere, not indulging in much wine, and not pursuing dishonest gain.

verses.textZh: 他们也必须先受考验，若没有可责之处，然后才让他们作执事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也必须先受考验，若没有可责之处，然后才让他们作执事。
verses.textZhCuv: 要存清洁的良心，固守真道的奥秘。
verses.textEnNiv: They must keep hold of the deep truths of the faith with a clear conscience.
verses.textEnEsv: They must hold the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
verses.textEnNkjv: holding the mystery of the faith with a pure conscience.
verses.textEnNlt: They must be committed to the mystery of the faith now revealed and must live with a clear conscience.
verses.textEnNasb: but holding to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
verses.textEn: They must keep hold of the deep truths of the faith with a clear conscience.

verses.textZh: 照样，他们的妻子 也要庄重，不说谗言，有节制，凡事忠心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，他们的妻子 也要庄重，不说谗言，有节制，凡事忠心。
verses.textZhCuv: 这等人也要先受试验，若没有可责之处，然后叫他们作执事。
verses.textEnNiv: They must first be tested; and then if there is nothing against them, let them serve as deacons.
verses.textEnEsv: And let them also be tested first; then let them serve as deacons if they prove themselves blameless.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let these also first be tested; then let them serve as deacons, being found blameless.
verses.textEnNlt: Before they are appointed as deacons, let them be closely examined. If they pass the test, then let them serve as deacons.
verses.textEnNasb: These men must also first be tested; then have them serve as deacons if they are beyond reproach.
verses.textEn: They must first be tested; and then if there is nothing against them, let them serve as deacons.

verses.textZh: 执事只可以作一个妻子的丈夫，善于管理儿女和自己的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 执事只可以作一个妻子的丈夫，善于管理儿女和自己的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 女执事 也是如此：必须端庄，不说谗言，有节制，凡事忠心。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, the women are to be worthy of respect, not malicious talkers but temperate and trustworthy in everything.
verses.textEnEsv: Their wives likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, but sober-minded, faithful in all things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise, their wives mustbe reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, their wives must be respected and must not slander others. They must exercise self-control and be faithful in everything they do.
verses.textEnNasb: Women must likewise be dignified, not malicious gossips, but temperate, faithful in all things.
verses.textEn: In the same way, the women are to be worthy of respect, not malicious talkers but temperate and trustworthy in everything.

verses.textZh: 那善于作执事的，就为自己得了好的位分，也因着相信基督耶稣得到大大的胆量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那善于作执事的，就为自己得了好的位分，也因着相信基督耶稣得到大大的胆量。
verses.textZhCuv: 执事只要作一个妇人的丈夫，好好管理儿女和自己的家。
verses.textEnNiv: A deacon must be faithful to his wife and must manage his children and his household well.
verses.textEnEsv: Let deacons each be the husband of one wife, managing their children and their own households well.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.textEnNlt: A deacon must be faithful to his wife, and he must manage his children and household well.
verses.textEnNasb: Deacons must be husbands of one wife, and good managers of their children and their own households.
verses.textEn: A deacon must be faithful to his wife and must manage his children and his household well.

verses.textZh: 我把这些事写给你，希望不久可以到你那里去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把这些事写给你，希望不久可以到你那里去；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为善作执事的，自己就得到美好的地步，并且在基督耶稣里的真道上大有胆量。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who have served well gain an excellent standing and great assurance in their faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: For those who serve well as deacons gain a good standing for themselves and also great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: For those who have served well as deacons obtain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who do well as deacons will be rewarded with respect from others and will have increased confidence in their faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who have served well as deacons obtain for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: Those who have served well gain an excellent standing and great assurance in their faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 假如我来迟了，你也可以知道在神的家里应该怎样行。这家就是永活神的教会、真理的柱石和根基。
verses.textZhCnvs: 假如我来迟了，你也可以知道在神的家里应该怎样行。这家就是永活神的教会、真理的柱石和根基。
verses.textZhCuv: 我指望快到你那里去，所以先将这些事写给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these instructions so that,
verses.textEnEsv: I hope to come to you soon, but I am writing these things to you so that,
verses.textEnNkjv: These things I write to you, though I hope to come to you shortly;
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing these things to you now, even though I hope to be with you soon,
verses.textEnNasb: I am writing these things to you, hoping to come to you before long;
verses.textEn: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these instructions so that,

verses.textZh: 敬虔的奥秘真伟大啊，这是众人所公认的，就是： "他在肉身显现， 在圣灵里称义 ， 被天使看见； 被传于列国， 被世人信服， 被接到荣耀里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬虔的奥秘真伟大啊，这是众人所公认的，就是： "他在肉身显现， 在圣灵里称义 ， 被天使看见； 被传于列国， 被世人信服， 被接到荣耀里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若我耽延日久，你也可以知道在神的家中当怎样行。这家就是永生神的教会，真理的柱石和根基。
verses.textEnNiv: if I am delayed, you will know how people ought to conduct themselves in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: if I delay, you may know how one ought to behave in the household of God, which is the church of the living God, a pillar and buttress of the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: but if I am delayed, Iwrite so that you may know how you ought to conduct yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: so that if I am delayed, you will know how people must conduct themselves in the household of God. This is the church of the living God, which is the pillar and foundation of the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: but in case I am delayed, I write so that you will know how one should act in the household of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and support of the truth.
verses.textEn: if I am delayed, you will know how people ought to conduct themselves in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.

verses.textZh: 大哉，敬虔的奥秘，无人不以为然！ 就是神在肉身显现， 被圣灵称义 ， 被天使看见， 被传于外邦， 被世人信服， 被接在荣耀里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大哉，敬虔的奥秘，无人不以为然！ 就是神在肉身显现， 被圣灵称义 ， 被天使看见， 被传于外邦， 被世人信服， 被接在荣耀里。
verses.textZhCuv: 大哉，敬虔的奥秘，无人不以为然！ 就是神在肉身显现， 被圣灵称义 ， 被天使看见， 被传于外邦， 被世人信服， 被接在荣耀里。
verses.textEnNiv: Beyond all question, the mystery from which true godliness springs is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was preached among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.
verses.textEnEsv: Great indeed, we confess, is the mystery of godliness: He was manifested in the flesh, vindicated by the Spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the nations, believed on in the world, taken up in glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Preached among the Gentiles, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Without question, this is the great mystery of our faith : Christ was revealed in a human body and vindicated by the Spirit. He was seen by angels and announced to the nations. He was believed in throughout the world and taken to heaven in glory.
verses.textEnNasb: Beyond question, great is the mystery of godliness: He who was revealed in the flesh, Was vindicated in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Proclaimed among the nations, Believed on in the world, Taken up in glory.
verses.textEn: Beyond all question, the mystery from which true godliness springs is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was preached among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.

verses.textZh: 圣灵明明地说，日后必有人离弃信仰，跟从虚谎的邪灵和鬼魔的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵明明地说，日后必有人离弃信仰，跟从虚谎的邪灵和鬼魔的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵明说，在后来的时候，必有人离弃真道，听从那引诱人的邪灵和鬼魔的道理。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and follow deceiving spirits and things taught by demons.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Spirit expressly says that in later times some will depart from the faith by devoting themselves to deceitful spirits and teachings of demons,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Spirit expressly says that in latter times some will depart from the faith, giving heed to deceiving spirits and doctrines of demons,
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Holy Spirit tells us clearly that in the last times some will turn away from the true faith; they will follow deceptive spirits and teachings that come from demons.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Spirit explicitly says that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to deceitful spirits and teachings of demons,
verses.textEn: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and follow deceiving spirits and things taught by demons.

verses.textZh: 这教训是出于说谎的人的虚伪，他们的良心好象被烧红的铁烙了一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这教训是出于说谎的人的虚伪，他们的良心好象被烧红的铁烙了一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因为说谎之人的假冒；这等人的良心如同被热铁烙惯了一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Such teachings come through hypocritical liars, whose consciences have been seared as with a hot iron.
verses.textEnEsv: through the insincerity of liars whose consciences are seared,
verses.textEnNkjv: speaking lies in hypocrisy, having their own conscience seared with a hot iron,
verses.textEnNlt: These people are hypocrites and liars, and their consciences are dead.
verses.textEnNasb: by means of the hypocrisy of liars seared in their own conscience as with a branding iron,
verses.textEn: Such teachings come through hypocritical liars, whose consciences have been seared as with a hot iron.

verses.textZh: 他们禁止嫁娶，禁戒食物。食物本是神所造的，是给信主和认识真理的人存感谢的心领受的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们禁止嫁娶，禁戒食物。食物本是神所造的，是给信主和认识真理的人存感谢的心领受的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们禁止嫁娶，又禁戒食物 ，就是神所造、叫那信而明白真道的人感谢着领受的。
verses.textEnNiv: They forbid people to marry and order them to abstain from certain foods, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and who know the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: who forbid marriage and require abstinence from foods that God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: forbidding to marry, andcommanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: They will say it is wrong to be married and wrong to eat certain foods. But God created those foods to be eaten with thanks by faithful people who know the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: who forbid marriage and advocate abstaining from foods which God has created to be gratefully shared in by those who believe and know the truth.
verses.textEn: They forbid people to marry and order them to abstain from certain foods, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and who know the truth.

verses.textZh: 因为凡神所造的，都是好的，只要存感谢的心领受，没有一样是可以弃绝的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为凡神所造的，都是好的，只要存感谢的心领受，没有一样是可以弃绝的；
verses.textZhCuv: 凡神所造的物都是好的，若感谢着领受，就没有一样可弃的，
verses.textEnNiv: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
verses.textEnEsv: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
verses.textEnNkjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be refused if it is received with thanksgiving;
verses.textEnNlt: Since everything God created is good, we should not reject any of it but receive it with thanks.
verses.textEnNasb: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with gratitude;
verses.textEn: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,

verses.textZh: 都因着神的道和人的祈求成为圣洁了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都因着神的道和人的祈求成为圣洁了。
verses.textZhCuv: 都因神的道和人的祈求成为圣洁了。
verses.textEnNiv: because it is consecrated by the word of God and prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: for it is made holy by the word of God and prayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: for it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: For we know it is made acceptable by the word of God and prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: for it is sanctified by means of the word of God and prayer.
verses.textEn: because it is consecrated by the word of God and prayer.

verses.textZh: 你若把这些事提醒弟兄们，就是基督耶稣的好仆役，常在信仰的话语上，和你所遵从美善的教训上得着培养。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若把这些事提醒弟兄们，就是基督耶稣的好仆役，常在信仰的话语上，和你所遵从美善的教训上得着培养。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若将这些事提醒弟兄们，便是基督耶稣的好执事，在真道的话语和你向来所服从的善道上得了教育。
verses.textEnNiv: If you point these things out to the brothers and sisters, you will be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished on the truths of the faith and of the good teaching that you have followed.
verses.textEnEsv: If you put these things before the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, being trained in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine that you have followed.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you instruct the brethren in these things, you will be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished in the words of faith and of the good doctrine which you have carefully followed.
verses.textEnNlt: If you explain these things to the brothers and sisters, Timothy, you will be a worthy servant of Christ Jesus, one who is nourished by the message of faith and the good teaching you have followed.
verses.textEnNasb: In pointing out these things to the brothers and sisters, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, constantly nourished on the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have been following.
verses.textEn: If you point these things out to the brothers and sisters, you will be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished on the truths of the faith and of the good teaching that you have followed.

verses.textZh: 总要弃绝世俗以及老妇的无稽之谈；要操练自己达到敬虔的地步。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总要弃绝世俗以及老妇的无稽之谈；要操练自己达到敬虔的地步。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是要弃绝那世俗的言语和老妇荒谬的话，在敬虔上操练自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Have nothing to do with godless myths and old wives’ tales; rather, train yourself to be godly.
verses.textEnEsv: Have nothing to do with irreverent, silly myths. Rather train yourself for godliness;
verses.textEnNkjv: But reject profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise yourself toward godliness.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not waste time arguing over godless ideas and old wives’ tales. Instead, train yourself to be godly.
verses.textEnNasb: But stay away from worthless stories that are typical of old women. Rather, discipline yourself for the purpose of godliness;
verses.textEn: Have nothing to do with godless myths and old wives’ tales; rather, train yourself to be godly.

verses.textZh: 因为操练身体，益处还少；唯独操练敬虔，凡事有益，享有今生和来世的应许。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为操练身体，益处还少；唯独操练敬虔，凡事有益，享有今生和来世的应许。
verses.textZhCuv: 「操练身体，益处还少；惟独敬虔，凡事都有益处，因有今生和来生的应许。」
verses.textEnNiv: For physical training is of some value, but godliness has value for all things, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.
verses.textEnEsv: for while bodily training is of some value, godliness is of value in every way, as it holds promise for the present life and also for the life to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: For bodily exercise profits a little, but godliness is profitable for all things, having promise of the life that now is and of that which is to come.
verses.textEnNlt: "Physical training is good, but training for godliness is much better, promising benefits in this life and in the life to come."
verses.textEnNasb: for bodily training is just slightly beneficial, but godliness is beneficial for all things, since it holds promise for the present life and also for the life to come.
verses.textEn: For physical training is of some value, but godliness has value for all things, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.

verses.textZh: 这话是可信的，是值得完全接纳的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这话是可信的，是值得完全接纳的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这话是可信的，是十分可佩服的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance.
verses.textEnEsv: The saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptance.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a trustworthy saying, and everyone should accept it.
verses.textEnNasb: It is a trustworthy statement deserving full acceptance.
verses.textEn: This is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance.

verses.textZh: 我们也是为这缘故劳苦努力，因为我们的盼望在于永活的神。他是万人的救主，更是信徒的救主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也是为这缘故劳苦努力，因为我们的盼望在于永活的神。他是万人的救主，更是信徒的救主。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们劳苦努力，正是为此，因我们的指望在乎永生的神；他是万人的救主，更是信徒的救主。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why we labor and strive, because we have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all people, and especially of those who believe.
verses.textEnEsv: For to this end we toil and strive, because we have our hope set on the living God, who is the Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
verses.textEnNlt: This is why we work hard and continue to struggle, for our hope is in the living God, who is the Savior of all people and particularly of all believers.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is for this we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of all mankind, especially of believers.
verses.textEn: That is why we labor and strive, because we have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all people, and especially of those who believe.

verses.textZh: 这些事你要嘱咐人，教导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事你要嘱咐人，教导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事，你要吩咐人，也要教导人。
verses.textEnNiv: Command and teach these things.
verses.textEnEsv: Command and teach these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things command and teach.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach these things and insist that everyone learn them.
verses.textEnNasb: Prescribe and teach these things.
verses.textEn: Command and teach these things.

verses.textZh: 不要叫人小看你年轻，总要在言语、行为、爱心、信心和纯洁上，都作信徒的榜样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要叫人小看你年轻，总要在言语、行为、爱心、信心和纯洁上，都作信徒的榜样。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可叫人小看你年轻，总要在言语、行为、爱心、信心、清洁上，都作信徒的榜样。
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one despise you for your youth, but set the believers an example in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no one despise your youth, but be an example to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let anyone think less of you because you are young. Be an example to all believers in what you say, in the way you live, in your love, your faith, and your purity.
verses.textEnNasb: Let no one look down on your youthfulness, but rather in speech, conduct, love, faith, and purity, show yourself an example of those who believe.
verses.textEn: Don’t let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity.

verses.textZh: 在我来以前，你要专心宣读圣经、劝勉和教导。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我来以前，你要专心宣读圣经、劝勉和教导。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要以宣读、劝勉、教导为念，直等到我来。
verses.textEnNiv: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to preaching and to teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, to teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: Till I come, give attention to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.textEnNlt: Until I get there, focus on reading the Scriptures to the church, encouraging the believers, and teaching them.
verses.textEnNasb: Until I come, give your attention to the public reading, to exhortation, and teaching.
verses.textEn: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to preaching and to teaching.

verses.textZh: 不要忽略你所得的恩赐，就是众长老按手时借着预言赐给你的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要忽略你所得的恩赐，就是众长老按手时借着预言赐给你的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要轻忽所得的恩赐，就是从前藉着预言、在众长老按手的时候赐给你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not neglect your gift, which was given you through prophecy when the body of elders laid their hands on you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not neglect the gift you have, which was given you by prophecy when the council of elders laid their hands on you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the eldership.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not neglect the spiritual gift you received through the prophecy spoken over you when the elders of the church laid their hands on you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not neglect the spiritual gift within you, which was granted to you through words of prophecy with the laying on of hands by the council of elders.
verses.textEn: Do not neglect your gift, which was given you through prophecy when the body of elders laid their hands on you.

verses.textZh: 这些事你要认真实行，专心去作，使众人看出你的长进来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事你要认真实行，专心去作，使众人看出你的长进来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事你要殷勤去做，并要在此专心，使众人看出你的长进来。
verses.textEnNiv: Be diligent in these matters; give yourself wholly to them, so that everyone may see your progress.
verses.textEnEsv: Practice these things, immerse yourself in them, so that all may see your progress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Meditate on these things; give yourself entirely to them, that your progress may be evident to all.
verses.textEnNlt: Give your complete attention to these matters. Throw yourself into your tasks so that everyone will see your progress.
verses.textEnNasb: Take pains with these things; be absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
verses.textEn: Be diligent in these matters; give yourself wholly to them, so that everyone may see your progress.

verses.textZh: 你要谨慎自己，留心自己的教训。在这些事上要有恒心，因为你这样作，不但能救自己，也能救那些听你的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要谨慎自己，留心自己的教训。在这些事上要有恒心，因为你这样作，不但能救自己，也能救那些听你的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨慎自己和自己的教训，要在这些事上恒心；因为这样行，又能救自己，又能救听你的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Watch your life and doctrine closely. Persevere in them, because if you do, you will save both yourself and your hearers.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep a close watch on yourself and on the teaching. Persist in this, for by so doing you will save both yourself and your hearers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed to yourself and to the doctrine. Continue in them, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep a close watch on how you live and on your teaching. Stay true to what is right for the sake of your own salvation and the salvation of those who hear you.
verses.textEnNasb: Pay close attention to yourself and to the teaching; persevere in these things, for as you do this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
verses.textEn: Watch your life and doctrine closely. Persevere in them, because if you do, you will save both yourself and your hearers.

verses.textZh: 不要严厉责备老年人，却要劝他好象劝父亲；劝青年人好象劝弟兄；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要严厉责备老年人，却要劝他好象劝父亲；劝青年人好象劝弟兄；
verses.textZhCuv: 不可严责老年人，只要劝他如同父亲；劝少年人如同弟兄；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but exhort him as if he were your father. Treat younger men as brothers,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not rebuke an older man but encourage him as you would a father, younger men as brothers,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father, younger men as brothers,
verses.textEnNlt: Never speak harshly to an older man, but appeal to him respectfully as you would to your own father. Talk to younger men as you would to your own brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not sharply rebuke an older man, but rather appeal to him as a father, and to the younger men as brothers,
verses.textEn: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but exhort him as if he were your father. Treat younger men as brothers,

verses.textZh: 劝年老的妇人好象劝母亲；存着纯洁的心，劝青年女子好象劝姊妹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 劝年老的妇人好象劝母亲；存着纯洁的心，劝青年女子好象劝姊妹。
verses.textZhCuv: 劝老年妇女如同母亲；劝少年妇女如同姊妹；总要清清洁洁的。
verses.textEnNiv: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
verses.textEnEsv: older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, in all purity.
verses.textEnNkjv: older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, with all purity.
verses.textEnNlt: Treat older women as you would your mother, and treat younger women with all purity as you would your own sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: to the older women as mothers, and to the younger women as sisters, in all purity.
verses.textEn: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.

verses.textZh: 要敬重供养那些无依无靠的寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要敬重供养那些无依无靠的寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 要尊敬那真为寡妇的。
verses.textEnNiv: Give proper recognition to those widows who are really in need.
verses.textEnEsv: Honor widows who are truly widows.
verses.textEnNkjv: Honor widows who are really widows.
verses.textEnNlt: Take care of any widow who has no one else to care for her.
verses.textEnNasb: Honor widows who are actually widows;
verses.textEn: Give proper recognition to those widows who are really in need.

verses.textZh: 寡妇若有儿孙，就应当让儿孙先在自己家里学习孝道，报答亲恩，因为这在神面前是蒙悦纳的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 寡妇若有儿孙，就应当让儿孙先在自己家里学习孝道，报答亲恩，因为这在神面前是蒙悦纳的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若寡妇有儿女，或有孙子孙女，便叫他们先在自己家中学着行孝，报答亲恩，因为这在神面前是可悦纳的。
verses.textEnNiv: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, these should learn first of all to put their religion into practice by caring for their own family and so repaying their parents and grandparents, for this is pleasing to God.
verses.textEnEsv: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to show godliness to their own household and to make some return to their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to show piety at home and to repay their parents; for this is good and acceptable before God.
verses.textEnNlt: But if she has children or grandchildren, their first responsibility is to show godliness at home and repay their parents by taking care of them. This is something that pleases God.
verses.textEnNasb: but if any widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show proper respect for their own family and to give back compensation to their parents; for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
verses.textEn: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, these should learn first of all to put their religion into practice by caring for their own family and so repaying their parents and grandparents, for this is pleasing to God.

verses.textZh: 那无依无靠独居的寡妇，她们仰望神，昼夜不住地祈求祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那无依无靠独居的寡妇，她们仰望神，昼夜不住地祈求祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 那独居无靠、真为寡妇的，是仰赖神，昼夜不住地祈求祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: The widow who is really in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day to pray and to ask God for help.
verses.textEnEsv: She who is truly a widow, left all alone, has set her hope on God and continues in supplications and prayers night and day,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now she who is really a widow, and left alone, trusts in God and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.textEnNlt: Now a true widow, a woman who is truly alone in this world, has placed her hope in God. She prays night and day, asking God for his help.
verses.textEnNasb: Now she who is actually a widow and has been left alone has set her hope on God, and she continues in requests and prayers night and day.
verses.textEn: The widow who is really in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day to pray and to ask God for help.

verses.textZh: 寡妇若奢侈宴乐，虽然活着也是死的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 寡妇若奢侈宴乐，虽然活着也是死的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那好宴乐的寡妇正活着的时候也是死的。
verses.textEnNiv: But the widow who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.
verses.textEnEsv: but she who is self-indulgent is dead even while she lives.
verses.textEnNkjv: But she who lives in pleasure is dead while she lives.
verses.textEnNlt: But the widow who lives only for pleasure is spiritually dead even while she lives.
verses.textEnNasb: But she who indulges herself in luxury is dead, even while she lives.
verses.textEn: But the widow who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.

verses.textZh: 这些事你要嘱咐她们，使她们无可指摘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事你要嘱咐她们，使她们无可指摘。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事你要嘱咐她们，叫她们无可指责。
verses.textEnNiv: Give the people these instructions, so that no one may be open to blame.
verses.textEnEsv: Command these things as well, so that they may be without reproach.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these things command, that they may be blameless.
verses.textEnNlt: Give these instructions to the church so that no one will be open to criticism.
verses.textEnNasb: Give these instructions as well, so that they may be above reproach.
verses.textEn: Give the people these instructions, so that no one may be open to blame.

verses.textZh: 人若不看顾自己的人，尤其不看顾自己一家的人，就是背弃信仰，比不信的人还坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若不看顾自己的人，尤其不看顾自己一家的人，就是背弃信仰，比不信的人还坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若不看顾亲属，就是背了真道，比不信的人还不好，不看顾自己家里的人，更是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who does not provide for their relatives, and especially for their own household, has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.textEnEsv: But if anyone does not provide for his relatives, and especially for members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially for those of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who won’t care for their relatives, especially those in their own household, have denied the true faith. Such people are worse than unbelievers.
verses.textEnNasb: But if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially for those of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.textEn: Anyone who does not provide for their relatives, and especially for their own household, has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

verses.textZh: 寡妇登记，年纪必须到达六十岁，只作过一个丈夫的妻子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 寡妇登记，年纪必须到达六十岁，只作过一个丈夫的妻子，
verses.textZhCuv: 寡妇记在册子上，必须年纪到六十岁，从来只作一个丈夫的妻子，
verses.textEnNiv: No widow may be put on the list of widows unless she is over sixty, has been faithful to her husband,
verses.textEnEsv: Let a widow be enrolled if she is not less than sixty years of age, having been the wife of one husband,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not let a widow under sixty years old be taken into the number, andnotunless she has been the wife of one man,
verses.textEnNlt: A widow who is put on the list for support must be a woman who is at least sixty years old and was faithful to her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: A widow is to be put on the list only if she is not less than sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.textEn: No widow may be put on the list of widows unless she is over sixty, has been faithful to her husband,

verses.textZh: 并且要有善行的见证：就如养育儿女，接待客旅，替圣徒洗脚，救济困苦的人，尽力行各样的善事等。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且要有善行的见证：就如养育儿女，接待客旅，替圣徒洗脚，救济困苦的人，尽力行各样的善事等。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有行善的名声，就如养育儿女，接待远人，洗圣徒的脚，救济遭难的人，竭力行各样善事。
verses.textEnNiv: and is well known for her good deeds, such as bringing up children, showing hospitality, washing the feet of the Lord’s people, helping those in trouble and devoting herself to all kinds of good deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: and having a reputation for good works: if she has brought up children, has shown hospitality, has washed the feet of the saints, has cared for the afflicted, and has devoted herself to every good work.
verses.textEnNkjv: well reported for good works: if she has brought up children, if she has lodged strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, if she has diligently followed every good work.
verses.textEnNlt: She must be well respected by everyone because of the good she has done. Has she brought up her children well? Has she been kind to strangers and served other believers humbly? Has she helped those who are in trouble? Has she always been ready to do good?
verses.textEnNasb: having a reputation for good works; and if she has brought up children, if she has shown hospitality to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has assisted those in distress, and if she has devoted herself to every good work.
verses.textEn: and is well known for her good deeds, such as bringing up children, showing hospitality, washing the feet of the Lord’s people, helping those in trouble and devoting herself to all kinds of good deeds.

verses.textZh: 至于年轻的寡妇，不要给她们登记，因为她们一旦情欲冲动而背弃基督的时候，就想结婚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于年轻的寡妇，不要给她们登记，因为她们一旦情欲冲动而背弃基督的时候，就想结婚。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于年轻的寡妇，就可以辞她；因为她们的情欲发动，违背基督的时候就想要嫁人。
verses.textEnNiv: As for younger widows, do not put them on such a list. For when their sensual desires overcome their dedication to Christ, they want to marry.
verses.textEnEsv: But refuse to enroll younger widows, for when their passions draw them away from Christ, they desire to marry
verses.textEnNkjv: But refuse the younger widows; for when they have begun to grow wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
verses.textEnNlt: The younger widows should not be on the list, because their physical desires will overpower their devotion to Christ and they will want to remarry.
verses.textEnNasb: But refuse to register younger widows, for when they feel physical desires alienating them from Christ, they want to get married,
verses.textEn: As for younger widows, do not put them on such a list. For when their sensual desires overcome their dedication to Christ, they want to marry.

verses.textZh: 她们被定罪，是因为丢弃了起初的信誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们被定罪，是因为丢弃了起初的信誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们被定罪，是因废弃了当初所许的愿；
verses.textEnNiv: Thus they bring judgment on themselves, because they have broken their first pledge.
verses.textEnEsv: and so incur condemnation for having abandoned their former faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: having condemnation because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they would be guilty of breaking their previous pledge.
verses.textEnNasb: thereby incurring condemnation, because they have ignored their previous pledge.
verses.textEn: Thus they bring judgment on themselves, because they have broken their first pledge.

verses.textZh: 同时，她们懒惰惯了，挨家闲游；不但懒惰，而且好说闲话，好管闲事，说不该说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同时，她们懒惰惯了，挨家闲游；不但懒惰，而且好说闲话，好管闲事，说不该说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且她们又习惯懒惰，挨家闲游；不但是懒惰，又说长道短，好管闲事，说些不当说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Besides, they get into the habit of being idle and going about from house to house. And not only do they become idlers, but also busybodies who talk nonsense, saying things they ought not to.
verses.textEnEsv: Besides that, they learn to be idlers, going about from house to house, and not only idlers, but also gossips and busybodies, saying what they should not.
verses.textEnNkjv: And besides they learn tobe idle, wandering about from house to house, and not only idle but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
verses.textEnNlt: And if they are on the list, they will learn to be lazy and will spend their time gossiping from house to house, meddling in other people’s business and talking about things they shouldn’t.
verses.textEnNasb: At the same time they also learn to be idle, as they go around from house to house; and not merely idle, but also they become gossips and busybodies, talking about things not proper to mention.
verses.textEn: Besides, they get into the habit of being idle and going about from house to house. And not only do they become idlers, but also busybodies who talk nonsense, saying things they ought not to.

verses.textZh: 因此，我愿年轻的寡妇结婚，生儿育女，管理家务，不给敌人有辱骂的机会；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我愿年轻的寡妇结婚，生儿育女，管理家务，不给敌人有辱骂的机会；
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我愿意年轻的寡妇嫁人，生养儿女，治理家务，不给敌人辱骂的把柄。
verses.textEnNiv: So I counsel younger widows to marry, to have children, to manage their homes and to give the enemy no opportunity for slander.
verses.textEnEsv: So I would have younger widows marry, bear children, manage their households, and give the adversary no occasion for slander.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I desire that the younger widows marry, bear children, manage the house, give no opportunity to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.textEnNlt: So I advise these younger widows to marry again, have children, and take care of their own homes. Then the enemy will not be able to say anything against them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I want younger widows to get married, have children, manage their households, and give the enemy no opportunity for reproach;
verses.textEn: So I counsel younger widows to marry, to have children, to manage their homes and to give the enemy no opportunity for slander.

verses.textZh: 因为有些人已经转去跟从撒但了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有些人已经转去跟从撒但了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为已经有转去随从撒但的。
verses.textEnNiv: Some have in fact already turned away to follow Satan.
verses.textEnEsv: For some have already strayed after Satan.
verses.textEnNkjv: For some have already turned aside after Satan.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am afraid that some of them have already gone astray and now follow Satan.
verses.textEnNasb: for some have already turned away to follow Satan.
verses.textEn: Some have in fact already turned away to follow Satan.

verses.textZh: 如果信主的妇女家中有寡妇，她就应该救济她们，不要让教会受累。这样，教会就可以救济那些无依无靠的寡妇了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果信主的妇女家中有寡妇，她就应该救济她们，不要让教会受累。这样，教会就可以救济那些无依无靠的寡妇了。
verses.textZhCuv: 信主的妇女，若家中有寡妇，自己就当救济她们，不可累着教会，好使教会能救济那真无倚靠的寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: If any woman who is a believer has widows in her care, she should continue to help them and not let the church be burdened with them, so that the church can help those widows who are really in need.
verses.textEnEsv: If any believing woman has relatives who are widows, let her care for them. Let the church not be burdened, so that it may care for those who are truly widows.
verses.textEnNkjv: If any believing man or woman has widows, let them relieve them, and do not let the church be burdened, that it may relieve those who are really widows.
verses.textEnNlt: If a woman who is a believer has relatives who are widows, she must take care of them and not put the responsibility on the church. Then the church can care for the widows who are truly alone.
verses.textEnNasb: If any woman who is a believer has dependent widows, she must assist them and the church must not be burdened, so that it may assist those who are actually widows.
verses.textEn: If any woman who is a believer has widows in her care, she should continue to help them and not let the church be burdened with them, so that the church can help those widows who are really in need.

verses.textZh: 那些善于治理教会的长老，尤其是那些在讲道和教导上劳苦的长老，你们应当看他们是配受加倍的敬重和供奉的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些善于治理教会的长老，尤其是那些在讲道和教导上劳苦的长老，你们应当看他们是配受加倍的敬重和供奉的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那善于管理教会的长老，当以为配受加倍的敬奉；那劳苦传道教导人的，更当如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The elders who direct the affairs of the church well are worthy of double honor, especially those whose work is preaching and teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the elders who rule well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in preaching and teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and doctrine.
verses.textEnNlt: Elders who do their work well should be respected and paid well, especially those who work hard at both preaching and teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: The elders who lead well are to be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
