verses.textEn: The elders who direct the affairs of the church well are worthy of double honor, especially those whose work is preaching and teaching.

verses.textZh: 因为经上说："牛踹谷的时候，不可笼住牠的嘴。"又说："作工的配得工价。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为经上说："牛踹谷的时候，不可笼住牠的嘴。"又说："作工的配得工价。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为经上说：「牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴」；又说：「工人得工价是应当的。」
verses.textEnNiv: For Scripture says, "Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain," and "The worker deserves his wages."
verses.textEnEsv: For the Scripture says, "You shall not muzzle an ox when it treads out the grain," and, "The laborer deserves his wages."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Scripture says, "You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain," and, "The laborer is worthy of his wages."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Scripture says, "You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain." And in another place, "Those who work deserve their pay!"
verses.textEnNasb: For the Scripture says, "You shall not muzzle the ox while it is threshing," and "The laborer is worthy of his wages."
verses.textEn: For Scripture says, "Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain," and "The worker deserves his wages."

verses.textZh: 控诉长老的事，除非有两三个证人，否则不要受理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 控诉长老的事，除非有两三个证人，否则不要受理。
verses.textZhCuv: 控告长老的呈子，非有两三个见证就不要收。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder unless it is brought by two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not admit a charge against an elder except on the evidence of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not receive an accusation against an elder except from two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not listen to an accusation against an elder unless it is confirmed by two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not accept an accusation against an elder except on the basis of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEn: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder unless it is brought by two or three witnesses.

verses.textZh: 常常犯罪的，你要当众责备他们，使其余的人也有所惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常常犯罪的，你要当众责备他们，使其余的人也有所惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 犯罪的人，当在众人面前责备他，叫其余的人也可以惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: But those elders who are sinning you are to reprove before everyone, so that the others may take warning.
verses.textEnEsv: As for those who persist in sin, rebuke them in the presence of all, so that the rest may stand in fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who are sinning rebuke in the presence of all, that the rest also may fear.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who sin should be reprimanded in front of the whole church; this will serve as a strong warning to others.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who continue in sin, rebuke in the presence of all, so that the rest also will be fearful of sinning.
verses.textEn: But those elders who are sinning you are to reprove before everyone, so that the others may take warning.

verses.textZh: 我在神和基督耶稣以及蒙拣选的天使面前叮嘱你，要毫无成见地持守这些话，行事也不要偏心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在神和基督耶稣以及蒙拣选的天使面前叮嘱你，要毫无成见地持守这些话，行事也不要偏心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在神和基督耶稣并蒙拣选的天使面前嘱咐你：要遵守这些话，不可存成见，行事也不可有偏心。
verses.textEnNiv: I charge you, in the sight of God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels, to keep these instructions without partiality, and to do nothing out of favoritism.
verses.textEnEsv: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus and of the elect angels I charge you to keep these rules without prejudging, doing nothing from partiality.
verses.textEnNkjv: I charge you before God and the Lord Jesus Christ and the elect angels that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing with partiality.
verses.textEnNlt: I solemnly command you in the presence of God and Christ Jesus and the highest angels to obey these instructions without taking sides or showing favoritism to anyone.
verses.textEnNasb: I solemnly exhort you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus and of His chosen angels, to maintain these principles without bias, doing nothing in a spirit of partiality.
verses.textEn: I charge you, in the sight of God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels, to keep these instructions without partiality, and to do nothing out of favoritism.

verses.textZh: 不要匆匆忙忙地替别人按手，也不要在别人的罪上有分，要保守自己清洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要匆匆忙忙地替别人按手，也不要在别人的罪上有分，要保守自己清洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 给人行按手的礼，不可急促；不要在别人的罪上有分，要保守自己清洁。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, and do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, nor take part in the sins of others; keep yourself pure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not lay hands on anyone hastily, nor share in other people’s sins; keep yourself pure.
verses.textEnNlt: Never be in a hurry about appointing a church leader. Do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not lay hands upon anyone too quickly and thereby share responsibility for the sins of others; keep yourself free from sin.
verses.textEn: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, and do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

verses.textZh: 因为你的胃不好，而且身体常常软弱，不要单单喝水，可以稍微用点酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你的胃不好，而且身体常常软弱，不要单单喝水，可以稍微用点酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你胃口不清，屡次患病，再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用点酒。
verses.textEnNiv: Stop drinking only water, and use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.
verses.textEnEsv: No longer drink only water, but use a little wine for the sake of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
verses.textEnNkjv: No longer drink only water, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t drink only water. You ought to drink a little wine for the sake of your stomach because you are sick so often.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not go on drinking only water, but use a little wine for the sake of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
verses.textEn: Stop drinking only water, and use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.

verses.textZh: 有些人的罪是明显的，就先受审判；有些人的罪是后来才显露出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人的罪是明显的，就先受审判；有些人的罪是后来才显露出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些人的罪是明显的，如同先到审判案前；有些人的罪是随后跟了去的。
verses.textEnNiv: The sins of some are obvious, reaching the place of judgment ahead of them; the sins of others trail behind them.
verses.textEnEsv: The sins of some people are conspicuous, going before them to judgment, but the sins of others appear later.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some men’s sins are clearly evident, preceding them to judgment, but those of some men follow later.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, the sins of some people are obvious, leading them to certain judgment. But there are others whose sins will not be revealed until later.
verses.textEnNasb: The sins of some people are quite evident, going before them to judgment; for others, their sins follow after.
verses.textEn: The sins of some are obvious, reaching the place of judgment ahead of them; the sins of others trail behind them.

verses.textZh: 照样，善行也是明显的，就算不明显，也不能隐藏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，善行也是明显的，就算不明显，也不能隐藏。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，善行也有明显的，那不明显的也不能隐藏。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even those that are not obvious cannot remain hidden forever.
verses.textEnEsv: So also good works are conspicuous, and even those that are not cannot remain hidden.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise, the good works ofsome are clearly evident, and those that are otherwise cannot be hidden.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, the good deeds of some people are obvious. And the good deeds done in secret will someday come to light.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise also, deeds that are good are quite evident, and those which are otherwise cannot be concealed.
verses.textEn: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even those that are not obvious cannot remain hidden forever.

verses.textZh: 凡负轭作奴仆的，应当看自己的主人是配受十分的敬重，免得神的名和道理被人亵渎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡负轭作奴仆的，应当看自己的主人是配受十分的敬重，免得神的名和道理被人亵渎。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在轭下作仆人的，当以自己主人配受十分的恭敬，免得神的名和道理被人亵渎。
verses.textEnNiv: All who are under the yoke of slavery should consider their masters worthy of full respect, so that God’s name and our teaching may not be slandered.
verses.textEnEsv: Let all who are under a yoke as bondservants regard their own masters as worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be reviled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let as many bondservants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and His doctrine may not be blasphemed.
verses.textEnNlt: All slaves should show full respect for their masters so they will not bring shame on the name of God and his teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: All who are under the yoke as slaves are to regard their own masters as worthy of all honor so that the name of God and our doctrine will not be spoken against.
verses.textEn: All who are under the yoke of slavery should consider their masters worthy of full respect, so that God’s name and our teaching may not be slandered.

verses.textZh: 奴仆有信主的主人，不可因为他们是弟兄而轻看他们；倒要加意服事他们，因为这些受到服事的益处的，是信主蒙爱的人。 你要把这些事教导人，劝勉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奴仆有信主的主人，不可因为他们是弟兄而轻看他们；倒要加意服事他们，因为这些受到服事的益处的，是信主蒙爱的人。 你要把这些事教导人，劝勉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人有信道的主人，不可因为与他是弟兄就轻看他；更要加意服事他；因为得服事之益处的，是信道蒙爱的。 你要以此教训人，劝勉人。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who have believing masters should not show them disrespect just because they are fellow believers. Instead, they should serve them even better because their masters are dear to them as fellow believers and are devoted to the welfare of their slaves. These are the things you are to teach and insist on.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who have believing masters must not be disrespectful on the ground that they are brothers; rather they must serve all the better since those who benefit by their good service are believers and beloved. Teach and urge these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brethren, but rather serve them because those who are benefited are believers and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
verses.textEnNlt: If the masters are believers, that is no excuse for being disrespectful. Those slaves should work all the harder because their efforts are helping other believers who are well loved. Teach these things, Timothy, and encourage everyone to obey them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who have believers as their masters must not be disrespectful to them because they are brothers or sisters, but must serve them all the more, because those who partake of the benefit are believers and beloved. Teach and preach these principles.
verses.textEn: Those who have believing masters should not show them disrespect just because they are fellow believers. Instead, they should serve them even better because their masters are dear to them as fellow believers and are devoted to the welfare of their slaves. These are the things you are to teach and insist on.

verses.textZh: 如果有人传别的教义，不接受我们的主耶稣基督纯正的话语，和那敬虔的道理，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人传别的教义，不接受我们的主耶稣基督纯正的话语，和那敬虔的道理，
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人传异教，不服从我们主耶稣基督纯正的话与那合乎敬虔的道理，
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone teaches otherwise and does not agree to the sound instruction of our Lord Jesus Christ and to godly teaching,
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and does not agree with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that accords with godliness,
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone teaches otherwise and does not consent to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which accords with godliness,
verses.textEnNlt: Some people may contradict our teaching, but these are the wholesome teachings of the Lord Jesus Christ. These teachings promote a godly life.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone advocates a different doctrine and does not agree with sound words, those of our Lord Jesus Christ, and with the doctrine conforming to godliness,
verses.textEn: If anyone teaches otherwise and does not agree to the sound instruction of our Lord Jesus Christ and to godly teaching,

verses.textZh: 他是自高自大，一无所知，反而专好问难争辩，由此产生妒忌、纷争、毁谤、恶意的猜疑，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是自高自大，一无所知，反而专好问难争辩，由此产生妒忌、纷争、毁谤、恶意的猜疑，
verses.textZhCuv: 他是自高自大，一无所知，专好问难，争辩言词，从此就生出嫉妒、纷争、毁谤、妄疑，
verses.textEnNiv: they are conceited and understand nothing. They have an unhealthy interest in controversies and quarrels about words that result in envy, strife, malicious talk, evil suspicions
verses.textEnEsv: he is puffed up with conceit and understands nothing. He has an unhealthy craving for controversy and for quarrels about words, which produce envy, dissension, slander, evil suspicions,
verses.textEnNkjv: he is proud, knowing nothing, but is obsessed with disputes and arguments over words, from which come envy, strife, reviling, evil suspicions,
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who teaches something different is arrogant and lacks understanding. Such a person has an unhealthy desire to quibble over the meaning of words. This stirs up arguments ending in jealousy, division, slander, and evil suspicions.
verses.textEnNasb: he is conceited and understands nothing; but he has a sick craving for controversial questions and disputes about words, from which come envy, strife, abusive language, evil suspicions,
verses.textEn: they are conceited and understand nothing. They have an unhealthy interest in controversies and quarrels about words that result in envy, strife, malicious talk, evil suspicions

verses.textZh: 就和那些心术败坏，丧失真理的人不断地争吵。他们视敬虔为得利的门路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就和那些心术败坏，丧失真理的人不断地争吵。他们视敬虔为得利的门路。
verses.textZhCuv: 并那坏了心术、失丧真理之人的争竞。他们以敬虔为得利的门路。
verses.textEnNiv: and constant friction between people of corrupt mind, who have been robbed of the truth and who think that godliness is a means to financial gain.
verses.textEnEsv: and constant friction among people who are depraved in mind and deprived of the truth, imagining that godliness is a means of gain.
verses.textEnNkjv: useless wranglings of men of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a meansof gain. From such withdraw yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: These people always cause trouble. Their minds are corrupt, and they have turned their backs on the truth. To them, a show of godliness is just a way to become wealthy.
verses.textEnNasb: and constant friction between people of depraved mind and deprived of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain.
verses.textEn: and constant friction between people of corrupt mind, who have been robbed of the truth and who think that godliness is a means to financial gain.

verses.textZh: 其实敬虔而又知足，就是得大利的途径，
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实敬虔而又知足，就是得大利的途径，
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了；
verses.textEnNiv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.textEnEsv: But godliness with contentment is great gain,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet true godliness with contentment is itself great wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: But godliness actually is a means of great gain when accompanied by contentment.
verses.textEn: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

verses.textZh: 因为我们没有带甚么到世上来，也不能带甚么去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们没有带甚么到世上来，也不能带甚么去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们没有带什么到世上来，也不能带什么去。
verses.textEnNiv: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.
verses.textEnEsv: for we brought nothing into the world, and we cannot take anything out of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.textEnNlt: After all, we brought nothing with us when we came into the world, and we can’t take anything with us when we leave it.
verses.textEnNasb: For we have brought nothing into the world, so we cannot take anything out of it, either.
verses.textEn: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.

verses.textZh: 只要有衣有食，就应当知足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要有衣有食，就应当知足。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要有衣有食，就当知足。
verses.textEnNiv: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.
verses.textEnEsv: But if we have food and clothing, with these we will be content.
verses.textEnNkjv: And having food and clothing, with these we shall be content.
verses.textEnNlt: So if we have enough food and clothing, let us be content.
verses.textEnNasb: If we have food and covering, with these we shall be content.
verses.textEn: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.

verses.textZh: 但那些想要发财的人，就落在试探中和陷阱里；又落在许多无知而有害的私欲里，使人沉沦在败坏和灭亡中；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那些想要发财的人，就落在试探中和陷阱里；又落在许多无知而有害的私欲里，使人沉沦在败坏和灭亡中；
verses.textZhCuv: 但那些想要发财的人，就陷在迷惑、落在网罗和许多无知有害的私欲里，叫人沉在败坏和灭亡中。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: But those who desire to be rich fall into temptation, into a snare, into many senseless and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: But those who desire to be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and harmful lusts which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.textEnNlt: But people who long to be rich fall into temptation and are trapped by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: But those who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap, and many foolish and harmful desires which plunge people into ruin and destruction.
verses.textEn: Those who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.

verses.textZh: 因为贪财是万恶之根。有人贪爱钱财，就被引诱离开真道，用许多痛苦把自己刺透了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为贪财是万恶之根。有人贪爱钱财，就被引诱离开真道，用许多痛苦把自己刺透了。
verses.textZhCuv: 贪财是万恶之根。有人贪恋钱财，就被引诱离了真道，用许多愁苦把自己刺透了。
verses.textEnNiv: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.
verses.textEnEsv: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils. It is through this craving that some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pangs.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the love of money is a root of all kindsof evil, for which some have strayed from the faith in their greediness, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.textEnNlt: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. And some people, craving money, have wandered from the true faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
verses.textEnNasb: For the love of money is a root of all sorts of evil, and some by longing for it have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.
verses.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.

verses.textZh: 但你这属神的人啊，应该逃避这些事，要追求公义、敬虔、信心、爱心、忍耐和温柔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你这属神的人啊，应该逃避这些事，要追求公义、敬虔、信心、爱心、忍耐和温柔。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你这属神的人要逃避这些事，追求公义、敬虔、信心、爱心、忍耐、温柔。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, man of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you, O man of God, flee these things. Pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfastness, gentleness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, O man of God, flee these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, gentleness.
verses.textEnNlt: But you, Timothy, are a man of God; so run from all these evil things. Pursue righteousness and a godly life, along with faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
verses.textEnNasb: But flee from these things, you man of God, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
verses.textEn: But you, man of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.

verses.textZh: 要为信仰打那美好的仗，持定永生；你是为这永生而蒙召的，又在许多的证人面前承认过美好的信仰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要为信仰打那美好的仗，持定永生；你是为这永生而蒙召的，又在许多的证人面前承认过美好的信仰。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要为真道打那美好的仗，持定永生。你为此被召，也在许多见证人面前，已经作了那美好的见证。
verses.textEnNiv: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
verses.textEnEsv: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called and about which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which you were also called and have confessed the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
verses.textEnNlt: Fight the good fight for the true faith. Hold tightly to the eternal life to which God has called you, which you have declared so well before many witnesses.
verses.textEnNasb: Fight the good fight of faith; take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and for which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
verses.textEn: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession in the presence of many witnesses.

verses.textZh: 我在赐生命给万物的神面前，并那在本丢．彼拉多面前见证过美好的信仰的基督耶稣面前嘱咐你，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在赐生命给万物的神面前，并那在本丢．彼拉多面前见证过美好的信仰的基督耶稣面前嘱咐你，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在叫万物生活的神面前，并在向本丢‧彼拉多作过那美好见证的基督耶稣面前嘱咐你：
verses.textEnNiv: In the sight of God, who gives life to everything, and of Christ Jesus, who while testifying before Pontius Pilate made the good confession, I charge you
verses.textEnEsv: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who in his testimony before Pontius Pilate made the good confession,
verses.textEnNkjv: I urge you in the sight of God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who witnessed the good confession before Pontius Pilate,
verses.textEnNlt: And I charge you before God, who gives life to all, and before Christ Jesus, who gave a good testimony before Pontius Pilate,
verses.textEnNasb: I direct you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,
verses.textEn: In the sight of God, who gives life to everything, and of Christ Jesus, who while testifying before Pontius Pilate made the good confession, I charge you

verses.textZh: 你当毫无玷污，无可指摘地持守这命令，直到我们主耶稣基督的显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你当毫无玷污，无可指摘地持守这命令，直到我们主耶稣基督的显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 要守这命令，毫不玷污，无可指责，直到我们的主耶稣基督显现。
verses.textEnNiv: to keep this command without spot or blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: to keep the commandment unstained and free from reproach until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: that you keep this commandment without spot, blameless until our Lord Jesus Christ’s appearing,
verses.textEnNlt: that you obey this command without wavering. Then no one can find fault with you from now until our Lord Jesus Christ comes again.
verses.textEnNasb: that you keep the commandment without fault or reproach until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: to keep this command without spot or blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.textZh: 到了适当的时候，那可称颂的、独一的全能者，万王之王，万主之主，必把基督的显现表明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了适当的时候，那可称颂的、独一的全能者，万王之王，万主之主，必把基督的显现表明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了日期，那可称颂、独有权能的万王之王、万主之主，
verses.textEnNiv: which God will bring about in his own time—God, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords,
verses.textEnEsv: which he will display at the proper time—he who is the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords,
verses.textEnNkjv: which He will manifest in His own time, Hewhois the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings and Lord of lords,
verses.textEnNlt: For, At just the right time Christ will be revealed from heaven by the blessed and only almighty God, the King of all kings and Lord of all lords.
verses.textEnNasb: which He will bring about at the proper time—He who is the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords,
verses.textEn: which God will bring about in his own time—God, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

verses.textZh: 只有他永远不死，住在不能接近的光里，没有人见过他，人也不能看见他。愿尊荣和永远的权能都归给他。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有他永远不死，住在不能接近的光里，没有人见过他，人也不能看见他。愿尊荣和永远的权能都归给他。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是那独一不死、住在人不能靠近的光里，是人未曾看见、也是不能看见的，要将他显明出来。但愿尊贵和永远的权能都归给他。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: who alone is immortal and who lives in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and might forever. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: who alone has immortality, who dwells in unapproachable light, whom no one has ever seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal dominion. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen or can see, to whom be honor and everlasting power. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: He alone can never die, and he lives in light so brilliant that no human can approach him. No human eye has ever seen him, nor ever will. All honor and power to him forever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: who alone possesses immortality and dwells in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
verses.textEn: who alone is immortal and who lives in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and might forever. Amen.

verses.textZh: 你要嘱咐那些今世富有的人，叫他们不要心高气傲，也不要寄望在浮动的财富上，却要仰望那厚赐百物给我们享用的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要嘱咐那些今世富有的人，叫他们不要心高气傲，也不要寄望在浮动的财富上，却要仰望那厚赐百物给我们享用的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要嘱咐那些今世富足的人，不要自高，也不要倚靠无定的钱财；只要倚靠那厚赐百物给我们享受的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Command those who are rich in this present world not to be arrogant nor to put their hope in wealth, which is so uncertain, but to put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the rich in this present age, charge them not to be haughty, nor to set their hopes on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Command those who are rich in this present age not to be haughty, nor to trust in uncertain riches but in the living God, who gives us richly all things to enjoy.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach those who are rich in this world not to be proud and not to trust in their money, which is so unreliable. Their trust should be in God, who richly gives us all we need for our enjoyment.
verses.textEnNasb: Instruct those who are rich in this present world not to be conceited or to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who richly supplies us with all things to enjoy.
verses.textEn: Command those who are rich in this present world not to be arrogant nor to put their hope in wealth, which is so uncertain, but to put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

verses.textZh: 又要嘱咐他们行善，在善事上富足，慷慨好施。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要嘱咐他们行善，在善事上富足，慷慨好施。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要嘱咐他们行善，在好事上富足，甘心施舍，乐意供给 人，
verses.textEnNiv: Command them to do good, to be rich in good deeds, and to be generous and willing to share.
verses.textEnEsv: They are to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous and ready to share,
verses.textEnNkjv: Letthem do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to give, willing to share,
verses.textEnNlt: Tell them to use their money to do good. They should be rich in good works and generous to those in need, always being ready to share with others.
verses.textEnNasb: Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous and ready to share,
verses.textEn: Command them to do good, to be rich in good deeds, and to be generous and willing to share.

verses.textZh: 这样，就为自己在来世积聚财富，作美好的基础，好叫他们能够得着那真正的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，就为自己在来世积聚财富，作美好的基础，好叫他们能够得着那真正的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 为自己积成美好的根基，预备将来，叫他们持定那真正的生命。
verses.textEnNiv: In this way they will lay up treasure for themselves as a firm foundation for the coming age, so that they may take hold of the life that is truly life.
verses.textEnEsv: thus storing up treasure for themselves as a good foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.
verses.textEnNkjv: storing up for themselves a good foundation for the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: By doing this they will be storing up their treasure as a good foundation for the future so that they may experience true life.
verses.textEnNasb: storing up for themselves the treasure of a good foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.
verses.textEn: In this way they will lay up treasure for themselves as a firm foundation for the coming age, so that they may take hold of the life that is truly life.

verses.textZh: 提摩太啊，你要保守所交托你的，避免世俗的空谈和冒称是知识的那种反调；
verses.textZhCnvs: 提摩太啊，你要保守所交托你的，避免世俗的空谈和冒称是知识的那种反调；
verses.textZhCuv: 提摩太啊，你要保守所托付你的，躲避世俗的虚谈和那敌真道、似是而非的学问。
verses.textEnNiv: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to your care. Turn away from godless chatter and the opposing ideas of what is falsely called knowledge,
verses.textEnEsv: O Timothy, guard the deposit entrusted to you. Avoid the irreverent babble and contradictions of what is falsely called "knowledge,"
verses.textEnNkjv: O Timothy! Guard what was committed to your trust, avoiding the profane and idle babblings and contradictions of what is falsely called knowledge—
verses.textEnNlt: Timothy, guard what God has entrusted to you. Avoid godless, foolish discussions with those who oppose you with their so-called knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: Timothy, protect what has been entrusted to you, avoiding worldly, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of what is falsely called "knowledge"—
verses.textEn: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to your care. Turn away from godless chatter and the opposing ideas of what is falsely called knowledge,

verses.textZh: 有些人自称有这知识，就偏离了真道。愿恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人自称有这知识，就偏离了真道。愿恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 已经有人自称有这学问，就偏离了真道。 愿恩惠常与你们同在！
verses.textEnNiv: which some have professed and in so doing have departed from the faith. Grace be with you all.
verses.textEnEsv: for by professing it some have swerved from the faith. Grace be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: by professing it some have strayed concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Some people have wandered from the faith by following such foolishness. May God’s grace be with you all.
verses.textEnNasb: which some have professed and thereby have gone astray from the faith. Grace be with you.
verses.textEn: which some have professed and in so doing have departed from the faith. Grace be with you all.
